Maria (PM): Quick sync — we need a final rollout plan for tomorrow's model swap that avoids traffic oscillation and gives customers an opt-out. High level: progressive warmstart by region, per-tenant dampening, fallback to quantized variant, and clear telemetry gates.

Josh (Eng): +1. Proposed ramp: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with a 20m stability window at each step. If any gate trips, auto-roll back to previous stable slice.

Leo (SRE): Clarify "gate" metrics please. I want concrete thresholds.

Josh (Eng): Sure — telemetry gates (per-slice):
```
error_rate_p95 >= 1.0% -> rollback
latency_p95 increase >= 30% over baseline -> rollback
request_qps drop > 15% (signal of throttling) -> pause ramp
cpu/gpu_util > 92% for > 3m -> trigger circuit-breaker
```
Also recommend a 3-strike rule in a 60m window before a full account-level rollback to avoid flapping.

Rachel (ProdOps): For dampening on per-tenant slices: any tenant with >100qps should have manual approval before >25% ramp. We should default large tenants into an "opt-in warmstart" bucket. Ida — any customer concerns here?

Ida (Sales): Customers on pilot (Acme, Nova) want being notified and the ability to opt-out. Can we add an opt-out API + email notify for those tenants? They don't want surprises.

Maria (PM): Yes — add an opt-out flag plus an outbound email from CS when the tenant is in a ramp slice. Also include a short rollback commitment window in the email.

Leo (SRE): Operational playbook: if a stability gate trips, the system should first: 1) reduce slice pct by 50% and re-evaluate after 10m, 2) if still failing, rollback slice to previous stable version, 3) if global capacity issue, fallback to quantized variant across region.

Josh (Eng): Implementation detail for fallback: automatic substitution to model-v1-quant when circuit-breaker fires. Also add a soft-degrade path where we disable expensive reranking (saves ~25% CPU) before a full rollback.

Rachel (ProdOps): We need observability hooks: per-tenant p50/p95, token-cost delta, model-quality regression score (simple BLEU-ish metric for our eval prompts). If quality delta > 4 points on monitored prompts, trigger alert but do not auto-rollback — manual review.

Maria (PM): Good distinction: automatic stability gates vs manual quality gates. Quality alerts go to #product and #support and require 1x engineering + 1x PM ack to proceed.

Josh (Eng): Operational flags config (example):
```
flags:
  warmstart_enabled: true
  dampening_window_mins: 60
  per_tenant_manual_threshold_qps: 100
  auto_fallback_model: model-v1-quant
  soft_degrade_steps:
    - disable_reranking
    - reduce_beam: 2
```

Leo (SRE): Add a health-check endpoint we can hit from the canary controller: `/canary/health?slice=eu-west1`. If it returns non-200 twice in a row, pause ramp and notify on-call.

deploy-bot: Canary controller: initiating warmstart slice=eu-west1 pct=5. started_by=Maria ts=1750002000 :rocket:

Ida (Sales): Thanks — please tag me on Acme/Nova tenants when they hit 25%. I'll coordinate comms.

Maria (PM): Decision summary:
- Ramp steps: 0->5->25->50->100 with 20m stability windows.
- Auto gates: error_p95, latency_p95, qps drop, util. Rollback logic: half-reduce -> re-evaluate -> rollback -> quantized fallback.
- Large tenants (>100qps): manual approval required; opt-out API + email notification.
- Quality regressions alert-only (manual ack).
- Observability: per-tenant p50/p95, token-cost delta, quality score.

Josh (Eng): I'll put the flag config PR up now and include the health endpoint and soft-degrade path. ETA: 4h.

Rachel (ProdOps): I'll add runbook steps and update the on-call checklist.

Leo (SRE): On-call, please watch eu-west1 for first 2 hours and be ready to toggle `warmstart_enabled=false`.

Maria (PM): Perfect — thanks team. If nothing else, we'll kick off at 09:30 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:
